content.title: About
content.content: Orange juice no pulp is 100 % fresh orange juice obtained without any concentrates, added vitamins or sugars. The juice is free of pulp, giving it a smooth texture and a bright citrus flavor.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The juice is stored at 0 °C–4 °C to preserve its aroma and vitamin content.
Pulp‑free orange juice is often used in sauces, marinades and cocktails.
Oranges of the ‘Valentin’ variety produce the sweetest and most aromatic juice.
Unlike concentrate, this product is not water‑reduced, retaining more natural enzymes.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: A 100 ml serving provides about 50 mg of vitamin C, supporting immunity and collagen synthesis.

items.title: Source of folate
items.content: Folate is essential for DNA synthesis and is especially beneficial for pregnant women.

items.title: Supports cardiovascular health
items.content: Potassium in the juice helps regulate blood pressure.

items.title: Antioxidant properties
items.content: Flavonoids and carotenoids protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: With about 90 % water, the juice contributes to the body’s fluid balance.

items.title: High natural sugar content
items.content: Even without added sugar, the natural fruit sugars may be a concern for people with diabetes.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: The acidic pH can irritate the stomach lining in individuals with gastritis or ulcers.

items.title: Citrus allergy
items.content: A small number of people may experience allergic reactions to oranges.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Drink the juice chilled on its own, or use it in smoothies, cocktails, marinades, sauces and desserts. Adding mint or ginger can enhance the flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the juice refrigerated at 0–4 °C. Once opened, consume within 3–5 days. Do not freeze, as this may alter texture and taste.
